message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The best area/SQNR tradeoff so far is the symmetric_preadd structure at coef_frac=14 (8552 um^2, 78.7 dB SQNR), which is only slightly worse numerically than the coef_frac=15 symmetric_preadd baseline (8520 um^2, 85.1 dB) while being far smaller than direct structures. Decreasing precision further has 3 legal unvisited neighbors and may reduce mapped area while keeping SQNR acceptable, balancing numerical quality and area better than switching architecture or changing rounding."}
